node.title: Re: Regex for ignoring paths
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As always with regexes, a single example is not really enough. For example, are the strings you're looking for always in parentheses? Is it really safe to assume that you don't want any matches that come after a slash? And so on. See [id://1201201].

Anyway, a negative lookbehind could work, as long as you set the conditions right: (? ([https://webperl.zero-g.net/regex.html#flags=g®ex=(%3F%3C!%5B%5C%2F%5Cw%5D)(%5Cw%2B%5C.%5Cw%2B)&samp1=%20%20%20%20%20%20Path%20to%20file%3A%20%2Fusers%2Fme%2Ffoo.baz%2Ffilename.ext%0Amy_content(word.other)|live demo])
